title: 美银一边上调年末目标：一边提示回撤风险，策略师称盈利才是意外
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So if it is a reminder of Bank of America writing, we're overdue for a pullback and entering a seasonly week period.
segments.zh: 所以，如果这是美国银行的提醒，我们早该迎来一次回调，而且正进入季节性疲软周。

segments.en: So if it joins us now for more, so be it a good morning. Good morning. I read you now earlier this week.
segments.zh: 所以，如果现在加入我们了解更多，那就这样吧。早上好。早上好。我本周早些时候读过你的观点。

segments.en: Just explain why you think we are due for that pullback. Yeah, I mean, I think there's a few reasons.
segments.zh: 请解释一下为什么你认为我们该回调了。是的，我认为有几个原因。

segments.en: One, if you look at positioning, we're at a point where it's not necessarily, you know, we're not in euphoria where everybody is 99% equities,
segments.zh: 第一，看仓位，我们还没到人人99%权益资产的狂热状态，

segments.en: but we are at a point where equity allocations have grown largely through performance of stocks.
segments.zh: 但权益资产配置已因市场表现而大幅增长。

segments.en: And when you think about where we are in the year, we've got September, October, to seasonally week months.
segments.zh: 想想今年所处的位置，九月、十月是季节性疲软的月份。

segments.en: I don't put a lot of stock in the seasonal trends, but I do think it's interesting that we're entering September, October,
segments.zh: 我不太看重季节性趋势，但我觉得有趣的是，我们正进入九月、十月，

segments.en: haven't had a pullback for about over six months now.
segments.zh: 已经超过六个月没有回调了。

segments.en: And pullbacks of 5% or more typically happen three times a year, so it just feels like things are moving kind of a little bit too well.
segments.zh: 而5%或以上的回调通常一年发生三次，所以感觉事情进展得有点太顺利了。

segments.en: And there's a reason. The unique, it's a multiple compression, then.
segments.zh: 这有原因。独特的是，接下来是估值倍数压缩。

segments.en: So, you know, our thesis this year played out, but what we got, and we actually nudged up our year-end target a little bit, and the reason was we had multiple compression in the spots where we thought we would see it,
segments.zh: 所以，我们今年的观点得到了验证，但我们实际看到的情况是，我们小幅上调了年底目标位，原因是估值压缩出现在我们预期的地方，

segments.en: but we saw a really outsized earnings surprise.
segments.zh: 但我们看到了非常超预期的盈利表现。

segments.en: So at some level, you know, one could argue that the multiple compression we had this year was really what we were expecting to see and the surprise was earnings.
segments.zh: 所以某种程度上可以说，今年我们经历的估值压缩正是我们预期会看到的，而真正的意外来自盈利。
